title: How F1 Predictor Pro Works | Predictions and Race Weekends
description: Learn how to make Formula 1 race and sprint predictions, when entries lock, how email verification works, and where to find standings and race analysis.
heading: How F1 Predictor Pro works
paragraphs: Create an account, verify your email, and choose a race weekend. Pick your podium finishers and pole position before the prediction window closes. Sprint weekends have a separate sprint prediction when available.

Predictions lock at the relevant session start. Follow the leaderboard after results are posted, and browse championship standings and race analysis. This is an independent fan project, not an official Formula 1 service.

questions.question: What is F1 Predictor Pro?
questions.answer: It is an independent Formula 1 prediction game for fans. You make picks for race weekends, then follow your results and the leaderboard after the event.

questions.question: What can I predict?
questions.answer: Choose your podium finishers and pole sitter. The prediction form also includes a constructor pick. Sprint weekends offer a separate sprint prediction when the event schedule includes one.

questions.question: When do predictions close?
questions.answer: Each prediction window closes when its relevant qualifying session begins. The app shows the deadline for each race weekend, so check the live schedule before submitting.

questions.question: Do I need to verify my email?
questions.answer: Yes. After creating an account, enter the six-digit code sent to your email. You can browse before verification, but you must verify to create, edit or delete predictions.

questions.question: Where can I follow the championship and race data?
questions.answer: The standings page shows driver and constructor championship points. The race analysis page shows available results, lap, position and pit-stop data for completed events. Data availability can vary by race.

questions.question: Is this an official Formula 1 website?
questions.answer: No. F1 Predictor Pro is an independent fan project and is not affiliated with Formula 1 or its companies.
